name: Deepmoss Spider Eggs
summary: Mebok Mizzyrix sees a chance to sell Deepmoss Spider Eggs to Booty Bay. Spider egg omelettes have become a craze there, and he sends travelers into the Stonetalon Mountains to gather fresh clutches for the overseas trade.

sections.title: A Taste for Luxury
sections.body: Booty Bay’s wealthy patrons and eccentric pirates have taken to spider egg omelettes, driving demand for rare ingredients across the Great Sea. Ratchet merchant Mebok Mizzyrix sees a chance to make a fortune by supplying the southern port. The Eastern Kingdoms have no supply of these spiders, so Mebok looks to Kalimdor’s wilderness for the eggs.

sections.title: Nests in the Mountains
sections.body: Deepmoss spider eggs lie in the Stonetalon Mountains, where the Venture Company has cut timber. You can find clutches beneath the trees still standing at Windshear Crag, or farther into the web covered depths of Sishir Canyon. Gathering them means facing venomous bites and thick infestations. Even seasoned scavengers may find the swarms hard to stomach.

sections.title: The Steamer Clam Express
sections.body: Fresh eggs must cross the sea before they spoil or hatch. Mebok works with Ratchet’s Wharfmaster Dizzywig to book freight on goblin merchant ships bound for the docks of Stranglethorn Vale. Once the eggs are packed into crates, Mebok earns a tidy profit from the high seas trade in fine food.

faq.q: Why does Mebok Mizzyrix want spider eggs?
faq.answer: Booty Bay has developed a taste for spider egg omelettes, but lacks a local supply of the eggs. Mebok Mizzyrix sees a chance for Ratchet’s goblin traders to profit by supplying the port.

faq.q: Where can the deepmoss spider eggs be found?
faq.answer: Deepmoss spider eggs can be found in the Stonetalon Mountains, northwest of the Barrens. Gather them beneath the remaining trees at Windshear Crag or deeper inside Sishir Canyon.

faq.q: Why does Mebok warn against Sishir Canyon?
faq.answer: Sishir Canyon holds massive spider swarms, dense cobwebs, and partially digested prey. Mebok warns that anyone with a weak stomach should gather eggs beneath the trees at Windshear Crag instead.

faq.q: Who ships the eggs once collected?
faq.answer: Mebok works with Wharfmaster Dizzywig at the Ratchet docks to send the eggs by merchant ship across the sea to Booty Bay.

faq.q: Are the eggs eaten raw or cooked?
faq.answer: The eggs are made into omelettes, an eccentric luxury dish for wealthy patrons and adventurers visiting Booty Bay’s taverns.

faq.q: Can players of both factions complete this task?
faq.answer: Yes. Ratchet is an open port run by the Steamwheedle Cartel, and Mebok Mizzyrix offers the work to both Alliance and Horde travelers.

angles.text: As a cook, you can see how port city diners make status symbols of strange, daring foods such as deepmoss spider eggs.
As a Horde traveler crossing the Barrens toward Stonetalon, you can earn quick coin in Ratchet to fund efforts against local harpies and Venture Company loggers.
As an Alliance scout traveling between the Barrens and Stonetalon’s night elven enclaves, you can use Ratchet’s goblin neutrality to earn traveling expenses.
